speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: For primary and secondary schools, MOE also considered the age profile of its students.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: For the junior colleges (JCs), a similar group of factors, including the age profile of the students, was considered.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: We should let the schools focus on their teaching and learning programmes to benefit their students.

speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: I know the renaming of merged schools is not an easy exercise.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The effort will be personalised and localised through the schools, the alumni associations and the School Advisory Committees.
